events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Today marks 30 years since the tragic death of influential rapper and actor Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55.

angles.name: Impact and Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years on, Tupac's music still resonates. What's your go-to track from a true hip-hop icon?

events.title: Tribute to Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: We remember legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who passed away 56 years ago today at the age of 27, and would have been 84.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: 56 years since we lost a true guitar visionary. What's the Jimi Hendrix track that still gives you chills?

events.title: Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic 'Abbey Road' album was released 57 years ago today in the UK.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: That zebra crossing. Those tracks. Happy 57th to The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' – an album that changed everything. What's your favourite moment from it?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' legendary frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and attitude are as powerful as ever. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis and Beady Eye frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the ultimate rock 'n' roll star, Liam Gallagher! What's your favourite tune featuring that iconic voice?

events.title: Imagine Turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released 55 years ago today in the US.

angles.name: Timeless Message
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A powerful message that still resonates today. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: The iPod is 25
events.blurb: Apple introduced the revolutionary first-generation iPod 25 years ago today.

angles.name: Game Changer
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? 25 years ago today, it changed how we listened to music forever. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating 64 years since the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No'.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, what's your favourite 007 moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: We remember John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering a Legend
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the enduring legacy of John Lennon. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedy legend and Monty Python star John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Genius
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! What's your favourite moment from his incredible career, from Monty Python to Fawlty Towers?

events.title: The White Album Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic double album, 'The Beatles' (known as 'The White Album'), was released 58 years ago today in the UK.

angles.name: Double Album Delight
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years of 'The White Album'! The Beatles' ambitious double LP still sounds as fresh and inventive today. What are your standout tracks?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: We honour the incredible legacy of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, 35 years since his passing at the age of 45. He would have been 80.

angles.name: Champion of Rock
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, we lost a true rock icon. Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: Rubber Soul Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' influential album 'Rubber Soul' was released 61 years ago today in the UK.

angles.name: A Shift in Sound
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul' – an album that showcased their evolving sound and lyrical depth. Which track stands out for you?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: We mark the 46th anniversary of the tragic passing of John Lennon, who died at 40 and would have been 86.

angles.name: Peace and Music
angles.copy: Forty-six years since the world lost John Lennon. His message of peace and incredible music continue to inspire. What's his most important song for you?
